turns.t: Um, hello? Sorry, I've had a nosebleed for about forty minutes, and it won't stop, and I'm a bit scared.
Sit forward, please, and keep pinching the soft part of your nose. I'm Dr Reilly. Which side is bleeding?
The right nostril, mostly. It started at breakfast, and it's been pouring on and off.
Have you swallowed much blood, or been sick?
A bit. I felt sick, so I spat it out. I've got blood all down my shirt.
Any history of nosebleeds? ~
Now and then, but never like this. ~
Did you knock your nose, or blow it hard?
No, nothing. It came on by itself.
Are you on any blood-thinning tablets?
Aspirin, 75 mg, once a day. That's all.
Any allergies to medicines?
None.
Any other conditions?
High blood pressure, and I take a tablet for it. And my heart, a stent, two years ago.
Do you drink alcohol?
A couple of pints most evenings.
I'll check your pressure and pulse. Keep pinching. ~
Okay. ~
Pulse 96, blood pressure 168 over 98, oxygen 98 percent.
Is that bad? ~
Your pressure is high, which can make nosebleeds worse. Let me look inside, I'll use the light and a suction. ~
Okay.
There's an active bleed from the front of the septum on the right side, a visible vessel, and a lot of clot in the nostril.
Can you stop it? ~
Yes. First, I'm going to put a swab soaked with a numbing and constricting solution in, and you hold it. ~
All right.
That's slowed it a lot. I'd say this is a bleed from a vessel at the front of the nose, made worse by high blood pressure and the aspirin.
Will it start again? ~
It might, so I'm going to cauterise the vessel with silver nitrate, a small sting, and then I'll put a small dressing in.
Does it hurt? ~
A brief sting.
Done. Keep your head forward, don't blow your nose for a few days, and avoid hot drinks and alcohol for 24 hours.
Okay. ~
Don't take any more aspirin until I've checked with your heart doctor, and I'll see you in the morning to check the nose and your blood pressure.
Thank you, doctor. ~
If it bleeds again, sit forward, pinch for fifteen minutes, and if it doesn't stop, come straight back.
Right. ~
